sn35.14:1.1: pubbe me bhikkhave sambodhāya anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi
sn35.14:1.2: ko nu kho rūpānaṃ assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ
sn35.14:1.7: ko dhammānaṃ assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇanti.
sn35.14:1.9: yaṃ kho rūpe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ rūpānaṃ assādo
sn35.14:1.10: yaṃ rūpā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ayaṃ rūpānaṃ ādīnavo
sn35.14:1.11: yo rūpesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ idaṃ rūpānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
sn35.14:1.16: yaṃ dhamme paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ dhammānaṃ assādo
sn35.14:1.17: yaṃ dhammā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ayaṃ dhammānaṃ ādīnavo
sn35.14:1.18: yo dhammesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ idaṃ dhammānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
sn35.14:2.1: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ channaṃ bāhirānaṃ āyatanānaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ. neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ.
sn35.14:2.2: yato ca khohaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ channaṃ bāhirānaṃ āyatanānaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ. athāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ.
sn35.14:2.4: akuppā me vimutti ayamantimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavoti.
